assets.fullPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for medieval fantasy browser game building upgrades. Create brand-new highly detailed painterly realistic isometric game building sprites, matching classic medieval gray stone castle art, dark charcoal slate shingles, heavy weathered oak beams, subtle burgundy accents, tiny warm amber torch/window light. Elevated isometric camera about35 degrees, front and right walls visible, camera/lighting absolutely identical throughout. Actual transparent background, no ground plane except small stone foundation directly under each building. No humans, text, numbers, labels, grid lines, UI, surrounding landscape, excessive smoke, or disconnected objects outside sprite. Upgrade progression is the central requirement: each successive sprite is visibly LARGER in its cell AND adds obvious major architectural features, taller roofline or larger wings. Preserve logical family identity while making all levels visually distinct. First occupies about55 percent of cell width/height, last about90 percent. Every silhouette fully contained, centered horizontally and grounded within its own equal rectangular cell with generous transparent gutters. No sprite overlaps a cell boundary. Crisp readable silhouettes at small game size. High resolution. BREWERY FAMILY. Exactly twelve complete isolated buildings in an even four-column by three-row grid. Level2 visibly bigger timber shed, two barrels and external copper kettle. Level3 larger stone plinth and open side brewing awning. Level4 taller gabled slate roof with brick chimney. Level5 add wide stone brewing annex and two copper vats. Level6 two-story brewing hall with external barrel rack and extra tall chimney. Level7 add rear malt-drying tower and bigger front loading platform. Level8 add second slate-gabled wing and rows of casks. Level9 add tall copper-domed kettle tower and stone courtyard wall. Level10 add covered wagon-size loading arch, multiple chimneys, larger stone wings. Level11 grand brewery complex with a second malt tower and copper pipework between large vats. Level12 largest prestigious brewery complex with three roofed wings, tall malt tower, twin copper kettle domes, huge barrels, broad stone loading yard and burgundy pennant. Each successive level must gain a substantial visible feature AND become larger than previous. Landscape atlas, regular4x3 cells. Only these twelve sprites.
